items.exampleEn: I buy new clothes every spring.
She wears a long blue dress.
My key is in my pocket.
He is wearing a blue shirt.
Wear a hat. The sun is hot.

items.sentenceEn: Our fat cat sleeps all day.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的胖貓整天都在睡覺。

items.audioEn: The tall man in the black hat is my father.
items.audioZh: 戴黑帽子的那位高個子男士是我爸爸。

items.sentenceEn: This dress is too big for me.
items.sentenceZh: 這件洋裝對我來說太大了。

items.stemEn: He is very ____, so his bed is very long.
items.stemZh: 他很高，所以他的床很長。

items.passageEn: Ben is tall, and he likes his clothes big. Today he wears a large white shirt with two pockets and a black hat. His shoes are old, but he loves them. His mother wants to buy him new ones.
items.passageZh: Ben 個子很高，他喜歡穿大件的衣服。今天他穿了一件有兩個口袋的大號白襯衫，戴了一頂黑帽子。他的鞋子很舊了，但他很喜歡。他媽媽想幫他買新鞋。

questions.questionZh: Ben 今天的襯衫是什麼顏色？
誰想幫 Ben 買新鞋？

rubricZh: 「鞋子」通常用複數 shoes，動詞配合用 are

referenceEn: All my clothes are in the box.
My clothes are all in the box.
rubricZh: clothes 一定是複數，動詞用 are
「都」可寫，例如 All my clothes…、My clothes are all… 等
